Hence each source row i can be\n    // relaxed independently of the others. Row k is snapshotted once per k so\n    // that all threads read a stable copy while others write their own rows.\n    // Iterations over k remain strictly sequential (barrier between each k).\n    const size_t n = numNodes;\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    unsigned int* const d = dist.data();\n    unsigned int* const p = path.data();\n    std::vector<unsigned int> rowK(n);\n    unsigned int* const rk = rowK.data();\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n        // Snapshot row k (serial copy, O(n) per k; negligible vs O(n^2) work).\n        #pragma omp single\n        {\n            std::copy(d + k * n, d + k * n + n, rk);\n        }\n\n        // Relax every source row i != k. j < n; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int cur = di[j];\n                const unsigned int nd = distIK + rowK_[j];\n                const bool better = nd < cur;\n                di[j] = better ? nd : cur;\n                pi[j] = better ? kk : pi[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}"},"output":"Edit applied successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"diff":"Index: /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r1/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\n===================================================================\n--- /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r1/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\n+++ /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r1/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\n@@ -43,26 +43,58 @@\n \n void floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                    std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                    const size_t numNodes) {\n-    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n-    // For each intermediate node k\n-    for (size_t k = 0;
